requiredFutureAcceptance: Retain pinned custom PBX, pinned Python-only carrier, network-free zero-exit preflight, two-container internal network, no published ports and existing resource/isolation/watchdog/owned-cleanup checks.
Register two synthetic identities with distinct ephemeral secrets; require exactly two expected contacts on distinct client UDP ports and retain both endpoint/AOR configurations.
Add only PJSIP/proof-agent to the empty private queue and require memberCount=1.
Caller INVITE authenticates to private Answer -> Queue(proof-queue,r,,,3) -> Wait(10) -> Hangup; timeoutpriority=app is set only in proof-queue before startup.
Agent validates private PCMU SDP and sends 180 only; host observes one Up caller in Queue and one Ringing agent with callerCount=1.

Require matching CANCEL request URI, Call-ID, original Via/branch, From, To and CSeq number. Agent sends 200 for CANCEL and 487 for the original INVITE; require a tagged non-2xx ACK on the original transaction.
Accept byte-identical INVITE/CANCEL retransmissions; reject foreign, modified, premature or unexpected requests and never answer the agent INVITE or establish an agent BYE dialog.
Require the original caller alone Up in Wait, zero queued callers, QUEUESTATUS=TIMEOUT, 3000 <= QUEUEWAIT_MS < 4000, ANSWEREDTIME_MS=0 and ABANDONED=TRUE.
Caller BYE/200 must drain channels; require C:0/A:1, member has taken no calls, member removal and exact initial queue-policy restoration.
Both authenticated unregistrations must return 200; require zero contacts/channels/callers/members, zero process exits and unchanged warmed bridge/inventory.
Remove only owned containers/network and both credential inputs plus generated PBX credentials. No builds, pulls, dependency installation or existing-PBX operation.

offlineValidation.description: Unit/mocked packet, lifecycle, timeout, mode-selection and orchestration tests only. No real sockets, runtime credentials, Docker resources or protocol traffic used.

limitations: No unanswered SIP runtime attempt has been authorized or executed; successful mocks are not runtime evidence.
The synthetic agent is deliberately narrow, not a general SIP stack or a real phone interoperability test.
The three-second application timeout includes host ringing-checkpoint overhead. Missing the observation window must fail, not manufacture a pass.
PCMU SDP negotiation does not verify RTP payload delivery or media quality; no audio is sent in this mode.
Earlier executed reports and their tool hashes remain immutable historical evidence of their executed revisions, not the newer offline sources.
Gate A remains incomplete; this does not authorize Gate C, production use, deployment or redistribution.
